notes:
Windows 0.7.2: Npcap detection fixed

The phone stays on 0.6.18.

Npcap installed without "WinPcap API-compatible Mode" keeps wpcap.dll and Packet.dll together in C:\Windows\System32\Npcap. The driver check and the capture loader now search that folder for dependencies, so the Network page no longer says Npcap is missing when it is installed.

Everything from 0.7.1 is included: the layer-2 Network page, one device at a time, Monitor, download and upload caps, Block, router names, online-only, the page motion, dialogs, and the Speed detail copy.

If 0.7.1 still shows the Npcap card, update to 0.7.2 and restart the app once. Devices can still be discovered without Npcap; monitoring, caps and Block need it.

The installer is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first run. 0.7.1 installs update in place; cards and settings are kept.
